clues: Nico got to the slips earlier than whoever hauled out the canoe.
Kenji turned up at either 1:15 p.m. or 1:45 p.m.
Between Nico and Hal, one brought the anchor and the other the net.
Whoever brought the bucket arrived sometime before Hal.
Of Priya and Hal, one carried the oars and the other carried the net.
The one with the net arrived at either 1:00 p.m. or 1:45 p.m.
The 2:00 p.m. arrival hauled out neither the canoe nor the dory.
The skiff's owner arrived earlier than whoever brought the cooler.
The dory's owner came at neither 1:30 p.m. nor 1:45 p.m.
The punt's owner got there exactly half an hour before the canoe's owner.
The person with the oars did not arrive at 1:30 p.m.
hints: Clues 3 and 5 both name Hal: which gear fits both? And which boat could possibly come at 2:00 p.m.?
Clues 3 and 5 both mention Hal and the net: put them together, then use clues 6 and 4. Later, test one of Priya's two possible times with a Suppose.
Suppose Priya came at 2:00. Then the cooler came by 1:30 and the skiff earlier (clue 8), and clues 9 and 10 leave 1:45 no boat. So Priya came at 1:00.
With Priya at 1:00, clue 1 puts Nico at 1:30 and Una at 2:00, with the kayak. Clue 1 again gives Hal the canoe.

solution.key_idea: Priya came at 1:00 or 2:00; supposing 2:00 pushes the cooler and skiff early and leaves 1:45 no boat, so Priya came at 1:00.
steps: Clue 3 gives the net to Nico or Hal, and clue 5 to Priya or Hal, so Hal brought it. Then Nico brought the anchor and Priya the oars.
Clue 6 puts Hal's net at 1:00 or 1:45, and clue 4 keeps Hal off 1:00. So Hal came at 1:45, Kenji at 1:15 (clue 2).
Clues 7, 8 and 10 leave 2:00 p.m. only the kayak. Clue 11 keeps Priya's oars off 1:30, so she came at 1:00 or 2:00.
Suppose Priya came at 2:00. Her oars take 2:00 and Hal's net 1:45, so the cooler came by 1:30, and the skiff before it (clue 8).
Clues 9 and 10 then leave 1:30 only the canoe, and 1:45 no boat at all. So Priya came at 1:00, not 2:00.
Clue 1 keeps Nico off 2:00, so Nico came at 1:30 and Una at 2:00, with the kayak. Clue 1 then gives Hal the canoe.
Clue 10 puts the punt at 1:15, Kenji's. Clue 9 keeps the dory off 1:30, so Priya hauled out the dory and Nico the skiff.
Kenji and Una had the bucket and cooler. Clue 4 puts the bucket before Hal, so it was Kenji's, and Una brought the cooler.
solution.epilogue: Kenji pulled the drain plug on his hauled-out punt, then pulled the work rowboat's plug too, out of habit, not noticing she was still afloat. He helped Felix bail her out by dusk.
